# @vllnt/convex-tokens

> TypeScript Convex component for expiring, revocable secret tokens stored only as SHA-256 or SHA-512 hashes: mint once, validate, revoke, scope, prune.

Install `@vllnt/convex-tokens` (unreleased builds from `main` use the `canary`
dist-tag). Peer dependency `convex@^1.45.0`; optional `react@>=18` for the
`./react` entry. Mount it with `app.use(tokens)` from
`@vllnt/convex-tokens/convex.config` and call it through
`new Tokens(components.tokens, options?)` from host queries, mutations and
actions. Methods: `mint`, `validate`, `revoke`, `list`, `getMetadata`, `prune`.
The client generates the raw token and hashes it with Web Crypto before any
call; the component stores only the digest, and `mint` returns the raw token
once. `validate` returns `{ valid: true, resourceRef? }` or `{ valid: false }`.
`revoke` returns `true` only for the call that moved the token to revoked, so
`validate` then `revoke` in one mutation redeems a token once. Every token
expires: `ttlMs` is clamped server-side into 60 000 ms to `maxTtlMs` (default
30 days; the ceiling wins when lower), default 24 hours. `list` returns metadata
only (never the hash), default 100 rows, integers above 1000 clamped, other
values throw. `prune` deletes up to 256 expired tokens per call, and a daily
cron deletes expired tokens and revoked tokens created more than 24 hours ago.
Invalid input throws `ConvexError` with `data.code` `INVALID_SCOPE`,
`INVALID_RESOURCE_REF`, `INVALID_TTL`, `INVALID_TOKEN_BYTES`,
`INVALID_TOKEN_HASH`, `DUPLICATE_TOKEN_HASH`, `INVALID_LIMIT` or
`INVALID_BEFORE`. The host owns auth and the meaning of `resourceRef`; there is
no rotation, usage count or revoke by id.

## When to use

- Use it when a link or one-off action needs a secret that expires, such as an
  email check, a password reset or a share link, and only its hash may be kept.
- Use it when a token must be revocable before it expires.
- Use it when a token must be redeemed at most once, even under concurrent calls.
- Do not use it when customers manage long-lived keys, rotate them or need usage
  counts: use `@vllnt/convex-api-keys`.
- Do not use it when you need a full invite → accept flow with roles: use
  `@vllnt/convex-invitations`.

## For coding agents

The docs are bundled in the package at `node_modules/@vllnt/convex-tokens/` and
match the installed version. Read them, and the shipped `src/`, before writing
code. The links below to `./` paths are files inside the installed package.
